w: Senior sadhus performed the murti pratishtha and inaugurated the newly built Swaminarayan Mandir in Khanpur.
Shri Manmohansingh, Former Union Finance Minister, met Swamishri and praised the construction of Akshardham in New Delhi.

Swamishri arrived at the Santram Mandir in Nadiad to pay his respects at the memorial shrine of the late Santram Maharaj, who had passed away recently. Swamishri offered flowers and tulsi leaves at his memorial shrine. Then Swamishri visited the office and garland the new successor Shri Ramdasji Maharaj.

After Swamishri completed his morning puja at Akshar Farm (which lies between Anand and Vidyanagar) his car was on its way back to the Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in Anand. On the way Swamishri sanctified the petrol pump of Yogeshbhai, a devotee. Swamishri remained seated in his car while Yogeshbhai garlanded him. Then at Swamishri's instruction the attendant sadhus showered the sanctified flowers on the premises of the petrol pump. During this time Yogeshbhai offered cashew nuts, raisins and dry fruits to Swamishri. Swamishri took a single raisin and held it between his thumb and finger. After blessing Yogeshbhai Swamishri proceed towards the mandir. After doing darshan of and offering prostrations to Thakorji' Swamishri started walking towards his room. The attendant sadhu enquired as to why he had held the raisin between his fingers till then. Swamishri remained quiet. Then on asking as to whether it was because he had not done Thakorji's darshan.
Swamishri replied briefly, "Yes."
Even at the age of 85 Swamishri abides by the rule of not eating anything prior to Thakorji's darshan. Swamishri's subtle devotion to Thakorji is unique and exemplary.

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
7 December 2004, Nadiad
285 devotees pilgrimaged by foot to the BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir from the villages of Mehlav, Torna, Kaletar, Kaliyel, Fatehpura and Swaminarayan Nagar.
10 Decembr 2004, Bharuch (Jhadeshwar)
Six BAPS youths cycled 70 km from the villages of Nahar and Samoj.
12 December 2004, Bharuch
326 boys and girls from the ages of four to ten pilgrimaged by foot from different suburbs to the mandir; the maximum distance being 10km.
Ajaybhai Shah, a chartered accountant from Clifton, America, had come for the darshan of Pramukh Swami Maharaj.

He said to Swamishri, "Swami! I keep feeling within that whatever understanding we develop should all be developed within. There is no need for outward show. I do not feel the need to apply tilak chandlo or wear a kanthi either. What is the use of outward show?"

Swamishri said, "When we wear a kanthi or apply tilak chandlo, it is not outward show. We do it because it is God's command. We have to please Him, and the kanthi is so that we remain aware that we have taken refuge in God. All this that we do is not for show. This devotion is not for show. It is not to show people. It is a matter of pleasing God, so keep up all of this."
How fine is this subtle line between outward show and devotion!

In the assembly, Viveksagar Swami was giving a parayan (scripture discourse), in which an incident came up: in 1947, when Shastriji Maharaj had gone to Jaipur, a swindler had cheated Babubhai Kothari. While telling this, Viveksagar Swami called on Pramukh Swami Maharaj as a witness. So Swamishri, seated on his seat, began to tell the incident.
Viveksagar Swami said, "Without the microphone, no one will be able to hear."
Swamishri said, "Even if they cannot hear, it does not matter. We can at least remember."
Saying this, he told the whole incident, remembering Shastriji Maharaj.
Such was Swamishri's simplicity, and such his love for telling any incident connected with his guru!

How delicate is this fine line between outward show and devotion!

Today was Swamishri’s 88th birthday. Due to the terrorist attack in Mumbai (26/11) Swamishri had cancelled the celebrations in Mumbai and at all BAPS mandirs and centres. Swamishri had strictly instructed that no mention of his birthday be made after his puja, and no garlands be offered to him. Swamishri performed his puja according to routine and gave audience to 128 devotees.

In the evening satsang assembly members of Anand bal mandal performed a drama ‘Jivishu Swamine Mate’ to commemorate BAPS Anand Mandir’s tenth anniversary. The drama brought to life the extraordinary stories of sacrifice and service by veteran devotees of Anand.

In conclusion, Swamishri appreciated the drama in his blessings, “The drama presented was most enjoyable because it revived memories about the services of devotees in the time of Shastriji Maharaj. They served with body, mind and wealth in testing times. They served to establish the knowledge of Akshar-Purushottam, to please Shastriji Maharaj and to be blessed with liberation for their souls.”

Swamishri’s health was fine. He did his routine darshan of Thakorji, performed morning puja and attended to phone calls and letters. At 7.15 p.m. Dr Lotlikar took a 2-D echo cardiogram of Swamishri’s heart. The result showed that Swamishri’s heart was fine and there was no reason to worry.

ds.t: The cyclone that turned to rain
w: At 9.00 Pramukh Swami Maharaj sat to feed Thakorji. Meanwhile he said to Yagneshwar Swami, sitting opposite, "How are you?"
Yagneshwar Swami said, "My health is fine, but please keep your health well."
Swamishri immediately said, "All that is in God's hands."
Yagneshwar Swami said, "You are the very form of God; everything is in your hands. Whatever you wish can happen."

Saying this, he told of an incident: "When you were staying at Bhadra, a severe cyclone had been forecast for our area. The day before, there was so much wind that there was going to be great devastation. At that time I phoned you, and you said just one sentence: 'We will pray to Maharaj; everything will calm down and go into the sea.' In fact, after your blessings, when I went to look outside in the afternoon, not even a leaf was moving. The next day the paper also reported that miraculously the cyclone had turned into rain."

After completing the patotsav (anniversary) ceremony of the mandir, Mahant Swami Maharaj came to his residence. At that time Arvindbhai, who was going about with him in service, asked, "You are the same Pramukh Swami Maharaj who came for the murti installation of the Surat mandir 20 years ago, aren't you?"
"The line continues," Swamishri gave a meaningful answer. In his words rang the echo of "The immortal legacy of the Gunatit, of Shri Hari, flowing on unbroken..."

Some well known artists who had served in the exhibition halls of "Swaminarayan Nagar", organised for Pramukh Swami Maharaj's birthday celebration, came today for the darshan and blessings of Mahant Swami Maharaj. One of them was Shri Arvind Babbal, who received the award for best director of TV serials in 2016.

For the last 35 years he had been smoking 45 cigarettes a day. He was so hooked on this addiction that once he had to go to Poland. A 13 hour direct flight was available, but that would mean bearing 13 hours of separation from cigarettes, which he would not accept. So he took connecting flights so that he could take a few puffs of 2 or 3 cigarettes every two hours. In this way he reached Poland in 36 hours. He wanted to do the same on the way back. But he learnt that smoking was strictly forbidden at the airport in Moscow. Anyone caught faced a heavy fine of 1 lakh 20 thousand rupees. Even so, Arvindbhai had decided, "I will have to smoke. If I get caught and have to pay the fine, I will pay it."

This hardened addict came into contact with the sadhus through serving in the "Muktanand" exhibition held in Pramukh Swami Maharaj's birthday celebration. Through them he arrived today for Swamishri's darshan.

Before coming here, the sadhus had talked to him about giving up the addiction. This was something he simply could not swallow. So he had come having decided at least this much: "Not 45, but I will have to smoke at least 10 cigarettes a day."

But as soon as he had Swamishri's darshan, the flow of love from Swamishri's eyes and his touch worked magic on him. Hearing his story, Swamishri looked into his eyes, rubbed his two hands together and said only, "Gone..."

That's all; with just these words his 35 year addiction went in one stroke! Tears poured from his eyes like the monsoon. With a choked voice he said, "I have been freed from this curse. Years ago I lost my father. And today, when Mahant Swami Maharaj held my hand, I felt that it was my father who held my hand and was blessing me."
His addiction went so completely that a few days later, when smoke from a youth's cigarette came onto his face, Arvindbhai even had an allergic reaction!

A few days after this incident, he also wrote a letter to Swamishri: "Jai Swaminarayan. My family and I are very grateful to you, very grateful. We are very fortunate that we received your blessings. Swamiji! I will not touch anything made of tobacco for the rest of my life; I took this vow at the time of your first darshan. Swamiji! By your blessings I have neither the slightest wish to smoke a cigarette, nor have I had any trouble. I hope for your blessings that my whole family and I may live by the principle that in the good of others lies our own good.
With respectful touch of your feet, a new devotee, Arvind Babbal."
Everyone experienced in person in Swamishri the truth of "The body of saints is like the philosopher's stone; iron turns into gold..."

Today Aksharpremdas Swami had brought a map of Jaipur to be sanctified by Mahant Swami Maharaj's glance. It showed how much satsang there is in which places and where the mandals (weekly groups) run. At present there are 10 areas where some mandal or other is running.
Aksharpremdas Swami requested, "Cast your glance so that satsang spreads everywhere else too."
Pointing it out, Swamishri said, "Yesterday in the announcements three young women's mandals were announced, and here there are only two."
Amazing! "First, it was yesterday, and on top of that something said in the announcements in half a second...! Swamishri remembers it?!"
On checking, it was found that there really are three young women's mandals, so three had been announced, but only two were running, so two had been written!
Everyone realised that it is Swamishri who listens most attentively of all to every announcement made in the assembly.

ds.p: On the flight from Jaipur to Ahmedabad
w: Hiteshbhai asked Mahant Swami Maharaj a question: "You had said, 'In different universes there are devotees just like these, and businesses and so on.' So do you also have a body just like this there? Suppose we become atmarup and go there, will we be able to recognise you?"

Swamishri said, "Yes, but the universe in which we were born is the right one. Maharaj forbade wishing for miracles. We should become absorbed only in these forms that we have attained. Do not keep any other wish."
Hiteshbhai asked a second question: "But in every universe the upasana must be this same one, of Akshar Purushottam, mustn't it?"

Swamishri said, "Yes, but when Maharaj comes... When Vairat Brahma did austerities for 50 of his years, then He came to this universe. In the same way He goes to each universe only once... So we are fortunate. Others who lived before did not get this benefit. All these look ordinary, you see, so one does not understand their glory. Maharaj said, 'We have kept your powers covered, otherwise everyone would become God.'"
Hiteshbhai said, "Looking at it like this, the Gunatit Satpurush has a lot of responsibility, so much responsibility for this universe and other responsibilities for other universes."
Swamishri burst out laughing and said, "There are infinite forms, you see! Each form is placed in each universe."
Hiteshbhai asked, "We get tired running just a little worldly business, but you run an infinite management... Don't you get tired at all?"
Swamishri said, "When one is atmarup one does not get tired. That body is different. In it there is no tiredness, no sleep, no yawning... nothing."
Hiteshbhai asked, "Which is better? To become brahmarup and sit in Akshardham? Or to become brahmarup, remain in this world and serve you?"
"Both are good," Swamishri said.
Hiteshbhai said, "In Akshardham one just has to sit, doesn't one? We would get bored there. Rather than that, let us stay with you and serve."
Swamishri said, "In Akshardham there is no tiredness or sleep... only bliss, bliss. In this body one feels tiredness and sleep, in the divine body one feels nothing."
Dipenbhai asked, "In Akshardham, Shriji Maharaj, Swami, Shastriji Maharaj and Pramukh Swami Maharaj must all be sitting in a row, mustn't they?"
Swamishri said, "Wherever they are, everyone has darshan. There is no far or near there."
Dipenbhai said, "So we don't need to look for the first or the last row!"
Swamishri said, "Yes... wherever you are, you have darshan of Maharaj. There is no far or near there."
Hiteshbhai said, "When you sit in the assembly, just pass your hand like this so that everyone attains the state."

Swamishri said, "What is, is. Maharaj took a human body, and if we wish for miracles in that, what is the point? The elephant became an ant, now should the ant become an elephant? To do that is ignorance."
Hiteshbhai said, "In this world, how it is: as one gets older one retires and lives peacefully. For you, the older you have become, the more responsibility has come."
Swamishri said with great feeling, "God alone does everything. We do nothing at all."
The line sung for Pramukh Swami Maharaj applies equally to Swamishri: "Shri Hari alone is the doer of all..."
After Mahant Swami Maharaj's meal, the attendant sadhu told an interesting incident:

"Vakil Bapu phoned from Bhavnagar: 'Swami! If it rains now, the cotton the farmers have sown will be badly damaged. Please bless that this does not happen.' Swamishri gave his blessings. Vakil Bapu had had many such experiences since the time of Pramukh Swami Maharaj... so he had full faith.
With the same ringing faith he had told a friend of his in Surat, 'My guru has given his blessings. Cyclone Ockhi will now be swallowed up in the sea and there will not be much damage in Gujarat.'
That friend, though well disposed, could not believe this at all. Vakil Bapu said, 'Let's see tomorrow.'

The next morning the friend was lost in amazement. The weather department's forecast had been certain: 'This is a terrible cyclone and it is definitely going to strike.' But it had changed course and really was swallowed up in the sea! Before Vakil Bapu he held his earlobes (in apology) and mentally bowed at Swamishri's feet."
Now, laughing, Swamishri showed with an action of his hand, "It went one mile and turned like this (at a right angle)."
"What can the Almighty not do! The Lord can do whatever He wishes in a moment!"
In the same spirit Nilkanthjivandas Swami said, "Everything is in your hands."
Swamishri's devotion as a servant immediately spoke out: "It is in God's hands."
